title.zh: After Congress killed its landmark crypto bill, the SEC unlocked the $77 trillion US stock market through tokenization
title.en: After Congress killed its landmark crypto bill, the SEC unlocked the $77 trillion US stock market through tokenization

current_state.zh: Two days after the Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act, the SEC opened a five-year Innovation Exemption allowing regulated US stocks to trade on permissioned blockchain venues, potentially bringing tokenized-equity activity onshore and expanding trading beyond exchange hours.
current_state.en: Two days after the Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act, the SEC opened a five-year Innovation Exemption allowing regulated US stocks to trade on permissioned blockchain venues, potentially bringing tokenized-equity activity onshore and expanding trading beyond exchange hours.
